title: STMicroelectronics and Hitachi SH-4 CPU Core Architecture, ADCS 7182230F
facts: STS MACH and STS MACL copy the corresponding 32-bit register into a general register.
STS FPSCR and STS FPUL read their corresponding FPU control registers without changing the saved register's bits.
SR.FD applies to these FPU control-register instructions as well as FMOV. The instruction faults before its own result when FPU execution is disabled.
implementation_policy: New static native context adapter and independent original-model guards return the existing authored host fault status -4 at the reached instruction. Earlier guest side effects remain. This is not a claim that hardware exception-vector delivery or physical timing is implemented. Historical source/model/proofs remain unchanged.
